logp.method_description: The log Po/w of these complexes ([LʹRe2], [LʹReRu], and [LʹReIr]) was determined through shake flask method using the previously published procedure. A known amount of each complex was suspended in water (presaturated with n-octanol) and shaken for 48 h on an orbital shaker.To allow the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. After the separation of two layers, UV-Vis spectroscopic analysis was performed. The log Po/w values(partition coefficient) were calculated with the help of the OD of the complex in water and octanol.
